tool.name: DIAuditor
tool.description: Computes quality metrics of data-independent acquisition (DIA) runs, per run and per isolation window
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in_cond.in && #if $in_cond.in_select == "no" mkdir ${' '.join(["'in_cond.in/%s'" % (i) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} && ${' '.join(["cp '%s' 'in_cond.in/%s/%s.%s' && " % (f, i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} #else cp '$in_cond.in' 'in_cond.in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_cond.in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_cond.in.ext)' && #end if #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out && #end if #if "out_windows_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_windows && #end if #if "out_mzqc_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_mzqc && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in #if $in_cond.in_select == "no" ${' '.join(["'in_cond.in/%s/%s.%s'"%(i, re.sub('[^\w\-_]', '_', f.element_identifier), $gxy2omsext(f.ext)) for i, f in enumerate($in_cond.in) if f])} #else 'in_cond.in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in_cond.in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in_cond.in.ext)' #end if #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_windows_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_windows 'out_windows/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_mzqc_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_mzqc 'out_mzqc/output.${gxy2omsext("mzqc")}' #end if #if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing #if "out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out' #end if #if "out_windows_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_windows/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_windows' #end if #if "out_mzqc_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_mzqc/output.${gxy2omsext("mzqc")}' '$out_mzqc' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.name: in_select
param.label: Run tool in batch mode for -in
param.option: Yes: process each dataset in an independent job

param.label: Input files, one per run: mzML, Thermo .raw and Bruker timsTOF .d (directory or .d.zip), as supported by this build
Input files, one per run: mzML, Thermo .raw and Bruker timsTOF .d (directory or .d.zip), as supported by this build
Total ion current of a spectrum
param.help: 'auto': the value in the file if present, otherwise the sum of intensities; 'file': only the value in the file, spectra without it count with 0 (like the original DIAuditor); 'computed': always the sum of intensities

param.label: Peaks counted per spectrum
param.help: 'all': all data points (like the original DIAuditor); 'nonzero': data points with an intensity above zero (differs for profile data)

param.label: Ion mobility settings that separate isolation windows with the same m/z range
param.help: 'auto': the FAIMS compensation voltage and the ion mobility range of the window (diaPASEF frames); 'faims': only the FAIMS compensation voltage (like the original DIAuditor); 'none': windows are defined by m/z alone

param.label: Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs
param.option: out (Table with one row per run)
out_windows (Table with one row per isolation window of each run)
out_mzqc (mzQC file with the run metrics)

data.name: out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_windows
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_windows
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_windows_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_mzqc
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_mzqc
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_mzqc_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Computes quality metrics of data-independent acquisition (DIA) runs, per run and per isolation window.
For more information, visit http://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_DIAuditor.html
